full_judgment: 2. The facts leading to the issuance of the Rule, in short, is that the late plaintiff Mohammad Ali, now being dead, instituted the above suit for declaration of his title into the suit land by adverse possession averring, inter-alia, that 0.15 acres of land appertains to settlement plot No. 209 corresponding to BS plot No. 575 of settlement khatian No. 60 of Noorpur mouza under Akhaura Police Station of Brahamanbaria district originally belonged to the defendant No. 1 who purchased the same from others on 25-6-1975.
